extDescription.message: Manage Vikunja tasks from your browser toolbar, with a task list, quick add and capture of the current page.

cmdAddSite.message: Add the current website as a task

configNoAccess.message: Vikunja is configured, but access to your Vikunja server is not granted yet.

accessNotGranted.message: Access to your Vikunja server was not granted. You can try again or open the settings.

hintBaseUrl.message: The address of your Vikunja instance, without a trailing slash.

hintToken.message: Create an API token in Vikunja under Settings → API Tokens. Give the token at least these permissions:

hintOptionalScopes.message: The optional features below need a few more scopes:

scopeQuickAddMagic.message: Quick Add Magic in the popup (*label, +project, !priority, @assignee): labels read_all & create, tasks_labels create, projects_users read_all

hintDefaultProject.message: Initial project for the popup list filter and for new tasks from the popup/capture. You can switch projects in the popup; the choice is remembered.

labelDueTodayDefault.message: Set due date to today by default

hintDueTodayDefault.message: New tasks get a due date of today (at Vikunja's nearest-hour time).

hintSortBy.message: Used for the popup task list. Manual sorting needs a default project (Vikunja only orders by position inside a project view); otherwise the list falls back to newest first. You can change the order and direction from the popup.

hintRememberLastSort.message: When enabled, the sort you pick in the popup is stored locally in the extension and overrides this default.

labelCustomFilter.message: Custom filter for the task list (optional)

hintCustomFilter.message: Applied to the popup task list. Setting a custom filter replaces the default done = false filter (which hides completed tasks). See vikunja.io/docs/filters.

hintElement.message: Add a Matrix Element web instance to get an “Add to Vikunja” button on every message. The extension asks for permission to read the page, then adds the task through your Vikunja connection.

labelElementReactAfterAdd.message: React with 📝 to the message after adding it to Vikunja

hintElementReactAfterAdd.message: After a message is added as a task, Element reacts to it with 📝 so everyone in the room can see it was captured. The reaction is sent by Element itself using your logged-in session.

hintElementTag.message: Every task added from Element gets this tag. Leave empty to add tasks without a tag. The tag is created in Vikunja automatically if it does not exist yet.

hintElementUrl.message: The address of your Element web instance. You will be asked to grant the extension access to it.

errValidUrl.message: Please enter a valid Vikunja URL (e.g. https://try.vikunja.io).

errValidToken.message: Please enter your Vikunja API token.

connectedNoProjects.message: Connected, but could not load projects: $1

errValidElementUrl.message: Please enter a valid Element URL (e.g. https://app.element.io).

elementAccessNotGranted.message: Access to that Element instance was not granted.

addedElement.message: Added $1. You can now add tasks from Element.

hintDueTodayCapture.message: Set the task due date to today

noProjectsFound.message: No projects found — create one in Vikunja first.

lostPermissions.message: Looks like we lost permissions to access your Vikunja. You can grant access below.

couldNotAddTask.message: Could not add task to Vikunja.

errRequestOrigin.message: Request did not come from a registered Element instance.

errNoRoomForEvent.message: No room found for the event.
